svg.aria-label: CIE 1931 chromaticity diagram with BT.709, DCI-P3 and BT.2020 gamuts
svg.text: Gamut: which colors a space can even name
CIE 1931 xy diagram. The horseshoe is roughly every color a human can see; each triangle is what a standard can encode.
Often quoted instead as a share of the whole diagram:
on how that is computed, so treat it as a rough yardstick.
What a wider gamut buys you
Deep cyans, laser greens and fire-engine reds simply do not
exist in BT.709. No amount of bit depth adds them.
Wider gamut needs more bits: the same 8-bit step covers more
color difference, so BT.2020 is defined at 10 and 12 bits.
A wide-gamut file shown as BT.709 looks oversaturated and
hue-shifted; the reverse looks flat and grey.
Gamut is about the primaries only. How bright the brightest white gets is a separate question - that is the transfer function, next.
